home.headline: Your body deserves clear answers.
home.subhead: Explore PCOS, hormones and reproductive health through clear explanations, interactive visuals and myth-busting guides.

medical_disclaimer: PCOS Unlocked is an educational resource. It does not provide a diagnosis or replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional.

myths.claim: Everyone with PCOS has ovarian cysts.
myths.explanation: The name can be misleading. Not everyone with PCOS has this ultrasound feature, and ovarian appearance alone does not define the condition.

myths.claim: Only people with larger bodies have PCOS.
myths.explanation: PCOS occurs across body sizes. Appearance cannot diagnose the condition.

myths.claim: PCOS means someone cannot become pregnant.
myths.explanation: Fertility experiences vary. Many people with PCOS can conceive, sometimes with clinical support.
There is no universal cure. Management is individualised and may include several forms of support.

myths.claim: Pads, tampons or menstrual cups cause PCOS.
myths.explanation: There is no established evidence that these menstrual products cause PCOS.

myths.claim: An online quiz can diagnose PCOS.
myths.explanation: Symptoms can overlap with other conditions. Diagnosis requires qualified clinical assessment.

quiz_policy: Educational feedback only; no diagnostic scoring, risk score or personalised medical advice.
content_rule: All medical statements require traceable references and clinical review before public launch.
